# Web2Go

Web2Go is a digital studio focused on AI website optimization, answer-engine readiness, technical SEO, structured data, performance, trust, and conversion-focused website design.

Localized website routes:
- English: /en
- Dutch: /nl
- Spanish: /es

Core services:
- AI website optimization
- Answer engine readiness
- Technical SEO
- Structured data and Schema.org JSON-LD
- Website redesign
- Business websites
- Landing pages
- Local SEO
- Performance optimization
- Content architecture
- Booking and lead capture systems
- Analytics and conversion tracking

Positioning:
Web2Go helps make business websites easier for humans, search engines, and AI systems to understand. Web2Go does not guarantee search rankings or AI recommendations.

Contact:
Use the localized consultation form on /en#contact, /nl#contact, or /es#contact.
